job.title: Head of Technical Services
job.description: <p><strong>Head of Technical Services – Hard FM / Engineering Leadership</strong></p><p><strong>Location:</strong> East London </p><p> <strong>Salary:</strong> £80,000</p><p> <strong>Budget Responsibility:</strong> £8m</p><p> <strong>Reports to:</strong> Technical &amp; Support Services Director</p><p> <strong>Team:</strong> Up to 6 direct reports, 30 indirect reports</p><p>We’re looking for an exceptional <strong>Head of Technical Services</strong> to take strategic and operational leadership of Hard FM services across a major East London portfolio. This is a senior management position with full P&amp;L accountability, responsibility for statutory compliance, and ownership of technical service delivery across a broad and complex estate.</p><p>If you’re a commercially astute technical leader with deep engineering knowledge, a passion for safe and compliant delivery, and experience shaping high-performing FM operations, this is a rare opportunity to drive strategy, influence transformation, and lead a large multidisciplinary team.</p><p><br></p><p><strong>The Opportunity</strong></p><p>As Head of Technical Services, you will:</p><ul><li>Lead the regional Hard FM operation, managing up to £8m in annual technical budgets.</li><li>Shape and implement the compliance and engineering strategy across building services, fabric, and associated FM technical functions.</li><li>Ensure all statutory, mandatory, and contractual requirements are met, including CDM, SFG20, HTMs, British Standards, and asset handback criteria.</li><li>Build strong working partnerships with Compliance, H&amp;S, Lifecycle, PMO, Commercial, Procurement, and Operational Leads.</li><li>Be a senior voice in client relationships, ensuring SLAs and KPIs are consistently met across all contracts.</li><li>Drive improvements in process, safety, service quality, and technical governance across a large and diverse portfolio.</li><li>Lead defect management, supplier performance, subcontractor oversight, and safe delivery of all technical works.</li></ul><p>This is a leadership role that blends operational control, technical authority, commercial ownership, and strategic input into the future of the FM service.</p><p><br></p><p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p><ul><li>Lead on Health &amp; Safety, promoting a zero-tolerance-to-harm culture.</li><li>Maintain legal and contractual compliance across all Hard FM operations.</li><li>Develop and implement policies, procedures, and technical standards in line with legislation and organisational strategy.</li><li>Collaborate with Hard Services Managers to ensure safe and compliant engineering delivery.</li><li>Build strong client relationships and represent G4S at senior meetings.</li><li>Own and manage Hard FM P&amp;L performance, ensuring efficient, value-driven service delivery.</li><li>Manage subcontractor performance, including monthly performance management with key suppliers.</li><li>Support operational teams by providing expert technical guidance on major issues.</li><li>Lead on compliance for Fire, Water, and Asbestos—including timely remedial actions.</li><li>Actively contribute to business development and evaluation of new opportunities or variations.</li><li>Oversee asset register accuracy, CAFM data, and evidence-based decision-making.</li><li>Support Lifecycle planning through detailed analysis of reactive and remedial tasks.</li><li>Track innovation, new technology, and product developments for potential adoption.</li><li>Recruit, develop, and manage Hard Services Managers and technical teams.</li><li>Ensure teams maintain required competencies and manage all people-related matters.</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>Key Competencies</strong></p><ul><li>Strategic thinker</li><li>Legislative &amp; mandatory compliance expertise</li><li>Strong commercial and financial acumen</li><li>Influential leader and change driver</li><li>Skilled stakeholder and relationship builder</li><li>Customer-focused and delivery-oriented</li><li>Able to manage complexity and embed continuous improvement</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>Skills &amp; Experience</strong></p><p><strong>Essential</strong></p><ul><li>Senior operational management experience in Hard FM or technical services.</li><li>Strong knowledge of CDM, SFG20, HTMs, and relevant British Standards.</li><li>IOSH or equivalent H&amp;S qualification; CIWFM or working towards it.</li><li>Experience managing lifecycle, PMO, and building defects.</li><li>Highly organised with strong analytical and auditing capability.</li><li>Strong communication skills and proven ability to influence at senior level.</li><li>Commercially astute with experience delivering cost-effective, safe, compliant services.</li><li>Solid operational knowledge of Hard FM in complex environments.</li></ul><p><strong>Desirable</strong></p><ul><li>Experience in PFI/PPP environments.</li><li>Experience in public buildings such as schools or hospitals.</li><li>Experience managing aged or complex estates.</li></ul><p><br></p><p><strong>Why This Role?</strong></p><ul><li>Senior leadership position with large budget ownership.</li><li>High visibility across the business and with major clients.</li><li>Significant scope to shape engineering strategy and performance.</li><li>Opportunity to lead meaningful improvements across safety, compliance, and service quality.</li><li>Ideal for someone seeking a high-impact technical leadership challenge.</li></ul><p></p>

job.title: Software Engineering Manager
job.description: <em><strong>hackajob</strong> is collaborating with <strong>BBC</strong> to connect them with exceptional tech professionals for this role.<br><br></em>Job Title: Software Engineering Manager<br><br>JOB DETAILS<br><br>Band: E<br><br>Contract: Permanent, Full-time<br><br>Department: Digital Distribution - Media Services<br><br>Location: London or Salford (preferred), or Glasgow, Cardiff, Newcastle, or Birmingham, with regular travel to London/Salford as part of hybrid working<br><br>Salary: £110,000-£130,000 depending on skills and experience<br><br>We’re happy to discuss flexible working arrangements. If you wish, you can outline your preference when you apply, but there’s no obligation at this stage.<br><br>PURPOSE OF THE ROLE<br><br>The BBC aims to be as strong in engineering as we are in content. Our digital products underpin our mission to inform, educate and entertain millions of people every day, and we’re looking for a Software Engineering Manager who can blend hands-on technical expertise with confident people leadership.<br><br>This is a unique opportunity for an experienced engineering leader who still enjoys engaging with technical decision-making. You will lead several multi-disciplinary teams who design, build and operate the BBC’s cloud-based media platform — ensuring it is scalable, resilient and ready for the BBC’s digital future.<br><br>You will develop and own the technical strategy for Media Services, working closely with product, architecture and operations partners. This is a role where your technical judgement and your leadership will have a tangible impact on the BBC’s audience-facing products.<br><br><strong>WHY JOIN THE TEAM<br><br></strong>Media Services sits at the heart of BBC Digital Distribution, powering iPlayer, BBC Sounds, News and Sport. Our systems handle more than 50 million daily plays and process thousands of hours of content every single day.<br><br>You’ll work with modern cloud technologies, a DevOps culture and teams who care deeply about engineering quality and continuous improvement. It’s an opportunity to help build products and services that truly matter — at a scale few organisations can match.<br><br><strong>Your Key Responsibilities And Impact<br><br></strong><ul><li> Lead and support several engineering teams delivering high-volume, high-availability media publishing workflows and consumer-facing services using AWS and modern frameworks.</li><li> Provide clear technical leadership, helping teams make thoughtful architectural and engineering decisions.</li><li> Recruit, mentor and develop engineering talent, creating an inclusive, collaborative and high-performing environment.</li><li> Shape and deliver the technical vision and strategy for Media Services in partnership with colleagues across Technology, Product Group and Media Operations.</li><li> Ensure our systems meet high standards of reliability, security and operational excellence.<br><br></li></ul><strong>Essential Criteria<br><br></strong><strong>YOUR SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE<br><br></strong><ul><li> Experience leading multiple engineering teams in an Agile environment, ideally with platform or infrastructure exposure.</li><li> A strong track record delivering complex, cloud-based solutions at scale (AWS preferable).</li><li> The ability to provide hands-on technical direction — whether through architecture, code review, prototyping or guiding engineering approaches.</li><li> Confident stakeholder management and the ability to influence across product, architecture and delivery teams.</li><li> Experience line-managing senior engineers and/or team leads and supporting their career development.<br><br></li></ul><strong>DESIRABLE CRITERIA<br><br></strong><ul><li> Familiarity with CI/CD and configuration tools such as AWS CodePipeline, GitHub Actions, Terraform, CloudFormation or Ansible.</li><li> Experience with large-scale media platforms (VOD or live streaming).</li><li> Knowledge of threat-modelling frameworks or zero-trust approaches.</li><li> Experience with event-driven architectures and RESTful API design.</li><li> A passion for improving developer experience, tooling and engineering craft.<br><br></li></ul>Before your start date, you may need to disclose any unspent convictions or police charges, in line with our Contracts of Employment policy. This allows us to discuss any support you may need and assess any risks. Failure to disclose may result in the withdrawal of your offer.

job.title: Director, Audit Risk & Compliance Services
job.description: We’re looking for a Director, Audit Risk and Compliance Services to join us in London or Bradford, United Kingdom<br><br>The Director, Audit Risk and Compliance Services provides leadership and strategic direction for Liberty Blume’s ARC department within Blume Business Solutions (BBS). The Director will ensure a quality customer service, focused delivery of Audit, Risk and Compliance services while leading the strategy for expansion into internal and external markets.<br><br><strong>The Purpose Of This Role Is To Provide<br><br></strong><ul><li>Leadership over the creation and execution of a strategic vision for Liberty Blume’s ARC function to build a scalable, tech-enabled business, supporting a clear growth plan</li><li>A team of talented, motivated ARC practitioners to support delivery of internal audit, risk and compliance services</li><li>Proactive and quality customer service to ensure existing customers’ expectations are exceeded and new customers immediately see value</li><li>Optimal efficiency of service, leveraging technology and automation</li><li>Deep domain expertise to not only underpin the credibility of services but also to ensure there is a platform for future growth.<br><br></li></ul>The successful candidate will be responsible for delivering ARC services (currently focused on internal audit, financial controls compliance and e-learning content development) to existing customers whilst developing and taking to market new products and scalable services to drive growth. This role will create a positive and supportive culture that encourages cross-functional collaboration, individual development, knowledge transfer and succession.<br><br>The Director will be responsible for maintaining key relationships and ensuring consistent dialogue with Liberty Global’s central ARC function, a key stakeholder.<br><br><strong>What will you be doing?<br><br></strong>The Director of ARC will lead the relevant service offerings across Blume and will:<br><br><ul><li>Develop the strategy for growing the Audit Risk &amp; Compliance function</li><li>Identify new customer opportunities through cross and upsell from existing clients of Blume and the federation of companies associated with Liberty Global</li><li>Identify new customer opportunities through working with business development and knowledge of the market in external and third party opportunities</li><li>Responsible for delivering IA and SOX testing under the guidance and supervision of Liberty Global</li><li>Lead the productions of E-Learning where required or requested</li><li>Responsible for delivery of ARC services for new customers as contractually defined</li><li>Ensure all ARC activity complies with relevant customer standards</li><li>Leads weekly delivery status reviews to Liberty Global and other customer stakeholders</li><li>Lead a team of high quality and qualified Audit Risk &amp; Compliance professionals ensuring an appropriate talent strategy is in place</li><li>Manage all financial aspects of the ARC function, including budget setting and monthly monitoring.</li><li>Monitor, track and ensure compliance with contractual SLAs to ensure quality and timeliness of deliverables as well as other relevant factors</li><li>Implement areas of technology that will enhance efficiency, effectiveness and insight for Internal Audit</li><li>Provide regular updates to the VP of LG’s Audit Risk &amp; Compliance and equivalent stakeholders in other customers sharing risks, trends and any outcomes from ongoing audits.</li><li>Act as the principal liaison between Blume ARC and the Liberty Global VP &amp; MD of ARC.<br><br></li></ul><strong>We Tend To Look For People With<br><br></strong><ul><li>Degree in accounting, finance, or business administration; professional certifications (CPA, ACA, CIA, CIPM, CISA) preferred.</li><li>Strong background in auditing and accounting, including Sarbanes-Oxley leadership and Big Four or equivalent experience in practice development and business growth.</li><li>Proven ability to lead complex, multi-jurisdictional engagements and deliver technology/AI solutions in audit, risk, and compliance.</li><li>Exceptional leadership, strategic thinking, and change management skills with a results-driven, entrepreneurial mindset.</li><li>Skilled at influencing senior stakeholders, building relationships, and working collaboratively across functions.</li><li>Excellent communication skills and ability to resolve complex issues effectively.</li><li>Passion for technology, innovation, and process automation; telecoms experience desirable but not essential.</li><li>Inspires and develops high-performing teams; flexible, hands-on, and proactive attitude.<br><br></li></ul><strong>Who We Are<br><br></strong>Liberty Blume, a Liberty Global company, is a rapidly growing business services provider, specialising in tech-enabled back-office solutions. Our mission is to deliver efficiency, scale and value to our customers through Business, Procurement and Financial Solutions. If you’re curious, customer centric and enjoy being one step ahead, join us on our scale up journey and unlock your freedom to grow!<br><br>Liberty Global is an equal opportunity employer. If you are curious and resilient with a limitless mindset, we’re eager to hear from you, no matter your background.

job.title: Engineering Director
job.description: <strong>Company Description<br><br></strong>Wise is one the fastest growing companies in Europe and we’re on a mission: to make money without borders the new normal. We’ve got 15 million customers across the globe and we’re growing. Fast.<br><br>Current banking systems don’t let us send, spend or receive money across borders easily. Or quickly. Or cheaply.<br><br>So, we’re building a new one.<br><br>Enter: our Global Product Tribe!<br><br><strong>Job Description<br><br></strong>The Global Product tribe at Wise owns nearly all aspects of the customer experience and core infrastructure powering the Wise Account, Wise Business, and Remittances (Transfer) products. We’re on a mission to build the world’s most global account—one that offers a truly local experience no matter where life or business takes our customers.<br><br>If you’ve used Wise, there’s a good chance you’ve spent 90% of your time engaging with products and experiences developed by teams in this tribe.<br><br>The tribe is organized into six key squads: Onboarding, Send, Receive, Spend, Account, and Grow—each responsible for a specific area of the product journey.<br><br>We’re looking for an inspiring and customer-obsessed engineering leader to join us—someone with a bias for action, a strong product mindset, and a passion for world-class user experiences. You’ll start by leading our Receive Squad, with the opportunity to grow your scope across more of the Global Product organization in the future.<br><br><strong>About The Receive Squad<br><br></strong>The Receive Squad builds the products that allow Wise customers to get paid from anywhere in the world and fund their accounts and transactions. Our goal is to offer the fastest, most transparent, most convenient, and fairly priced ways for customers to receive money globally.<br><br>Today, we provide local account details in 10+ countries, and our PayIn platform processes over £200 billion annually in incoming payments. We're also laying the foundation for payment facilitation capabilities to support merchants and global businesses. As the world becomes more interconnected, our customers increasingly rely on Wise to handle all their payment needs through a single global account.<br><br><strong>What You’ll Do<br><br></strong><ul><li>Drive the technical and product direction for engineering teams within the Receive Squad, aligning closely with product and design leads to build customer-first solutions.</li><li>Be hands-on when needed—with a strong eye for system design, you’ll dive into technical details to help teams make smart architectural decisions and unblock complex challenges.</li><li>Build and scale high-performing engineering teams that can support Wise’s continued hypergrowth and complex global operations.</li><li>Unblock teams and enable them to move faster in an increasingly large and complex global organization by reducing inefficiencies, cutting unnecessary admin, and improving team focus.</li><li>Navigate risk, compliance, and regulatory challenges while maintaining agility—working iteratively to release product improvements without compromising safety or speed.</li><li>Collaborate closely with neighbouring tribes—including Regional (local payment schemes, regulators, tailoring product to local needs), Finance &amp; Treasury (safeguarding, liquidity management, accounting &amp; reporting), and Servicing (Financial Crime, KYC, and account monitoring)—to ensure alignment across Wise’s global platform.</li><li>Influence and align with Wise’s broader technical and product vision across squads and tribes.</li><li>Mentor engineering managers and technical leads, and create the conditions for autonomous, empowered teams to thrive.</li><li>Champion a healthy engineering culture rooted in continuous improvement, technical excellence, and customer-centricity.<br><br></li></ul><strong>What’s In It For You<br><br></strong><ul><li>A chance to lead the teams building the core infrastructure powering a global financial platform used by millions.</li><li>The opportunity to shape Wise’s global account experience as we scale to serve more regions, more use cases, and more complexity.</li><li>A key role in navigating the intersection of tech, regulation, finance, and customer experience, working across Wise’s most critical domains.</li><li>The ability to make a tangible difference by simplifying internal operations and accelerating delivery—enabling your teams to do their best work.</li><li>A collaborative, no-blame culture built on transparency, ownership, and trust.</li><li>The autonomy to build and scale teams your way—supported by strong peers and leadership who care deeply about impact and people.<br><br></li></ul><strong>Qualifications<br><br></strong><ul><li>You’re an experienced engineering leader who has led complex, high-impact teams at scale.</li><li>You care deeply about building products that solve real customer problems—and you bring that empathy into how you lead and prioritize.</li><li>You bring a strong technical foundation, with a solid eye for system design, architecture, and scalability, and you’re not afraid to roll up your sleeves and go deep when teams need help.</li><li>You’ve worked in or with regulated industries and know how to balance compliance, speed, and customer value.</li><li>You’re energized by removing blockers, simplifying processes, and enabling teams to ship faster.</li><li>You’re comfortable leading in a globally distributed, cross-functional environment and collaborating across a diverse set of teams.</li><li>You thrive in a
